decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis uses the firm's maintained market-data databases at low marginal cost and adds analytical value for utilities on the central platform.
Gas tariff comparison is close to the core offer and shares the daily updated data, so it is cheap to keep and supports the platform.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is core-adjacent with its own page and steady demand from suppliers.
The area definition tool underpins the other location-based products and fits the integrated platform strategy.

Site-specific tariff comparison draws on shared data and is cheap to maintain, though its low website prominence and the earlier withdrawal of the similar product line D leave a somewhat higher risk of consolidation.
